tagline: Drag them through the Hut's door onto a little board that belongs to her

featuredCards.title: Chicken Legs
featuredCards.caption: The Hut walks. She parks the front door on top of you and hurts everything it stomps through on the way.

featuredCards.title: Abduction
featuredCards.caption: The moment the deck is built around: the opposing fighter is placed inside the Hut, and she steps in after them.

featuredCards.title: The Devil's Grandmother
featuredCards.caption: Inside her own walls the same card is worth six. Half the deck reads the same way — being home is the buff.

featuredCards.title: Spinning Rampage
featuredCards.caption: The rent. Everyone locked in the Hut takes two, and there is no combat to win your way out of it.
